description: This file defines the main Functions class for PHPSpreadsheet's calculation module, providing constants, configuration methods, and utility functions for spreadsheet calculations, such as setting compatibility modes, handling date formats, and checking value types.

classes.name: Functions
classes.description: Provides calculation functions, constants, and configuration settings for spreadsheet calculations, including type checks, error generation, and date format handling.

methods.name: setCompatibilityMode
methods.description: Sets the calculation compatibility mode (Excel, Gnumeric, OpenOffice).

methods.name: getCompatibilityMode
methods.description: Retrieves the current calculation compatibility mode.

methods.name: setReturnDateType
methods.description: Sets the format for returning date values (Unix timestamp, PHP DateTime object, Excel serial).

methods.name: getReturnDateType
methods.description: Retrieves the current date return format setting.

methods.name: DUMMY
methods.description: Returns a placeholder string indicating a not-yet-implemented feature.

methods.name: isMatrixValue
methods.description: Checks if the input string matches the matrix value pattern.

methods.name: isValue
methods.description: Checks if the input string matches a simple value pattern (no dots).

methods.name: isCellValue
methods.description: Checks if the input string matches a cell value pattern (more than one dot).

methods.name: ifCondition
methods.description: Creates a conditional expression string based on the input condition.

methods.name: null
methods.description: Returns the #NULL! error value.

methods.name: NAN
methods.description: Returns the #NUM! error value.

methods.name: REF
methods.description: Returns the #REF! error value.

methods.name: NA
methods.description: Returns the #N/A error value.

methods.name: VALUE
methods.description: Returns the #VALUE! error value.

methods.name: NAME
methods.description: Returns the #NAME? error value.

methods.name: DIV0
methods.description: Returns the division by zero error (#DIV/0!).

methods.name: errorType
methods.description: Returns the Excel error type for a given value.

methods.name: isBlank
methods.description: Checks if a value is blank.

methods.name: isErr
methods.description: Checks if a value is an error.

methods.name: isError
methods.description: Checks if a value is an error (alias of isErr).

methods.name: isNa
methods.description: Checks if a value is #N/A.

methods.name: isEven
methods.description: Checks if a number is even.

methods.name: isOdd
methods.description: Checks if a number is odd.

methods.name: isNumber
methods.description: Checks if a value is numeric.

methods.name: isLogical
methods.description: Checks if a value is logical (boolean).

methods.name: isText
methods.description: Checks if a value is text.

methods.name: isNonText
methods.description: Checks if a value is non-text.

methods.name: n
methods.description: Converts a value to a number, handling date and boolean conversions.

methods.name: TYPE
methods.description: Returns a number indicating the type of a value.

methods.name: flattenArray
methods.description: Flattens a multi-dimensional array into a single-dimensional array.

methods.name: scalar
methods.description: Extracts a scalar value from an array.

methods.name: flattenArrayIndexed
methods.description: Flattens a multi-dimensional array into a single array with index keys.

methods.name: flattenSingleValue
methods.description: Extracts the first scalar value from an array.

methods.name: isFormula
methods.description: Checks if a cell or value is a formula.

methods.name: expandDefinedName
methods.description: Resolves a named reference to its cell address.

methods.name: trimTrailingRange
methods.description: Removes the trailing range part from a cell reference.

methods.name: trimSheetFromCellReference
methods.description: Removes the sheet name from a cell reference.
